title: Isiluleko Esisekelwe Ebulumkweni
intro: Khawuthelekelele umi ecaleni komntu owaziwayo kungekhona ngemimangaliso okanye ngobukumkani, kodwa ngamazwi asakhokela iintliziyo nanamhlanje. Lo mkhonzi ka-Allah wafumana isipho esixabisekileyo waza wathululela umbulelo kuyo yonke ingcebiso enikwa umfundi oselula othandekayo.
clues: Ndisikelelwe nguAllah ngobulumko, kwaye ndayalelwa ukuba ndibulele ngabo.
Ndithethe nonyana wam ngesiluleko esithambileyo, ndimlumkisa ngothando nangenkathalo.
Ndixelele unyana wam ukuba ukunxulumana namaqabane no-Allah kuphosakele kakhulu.
Ndimcebise unyana wam ukuba athandaze, ayalele okulungileyo, athintele okubi, aze anyamezele ngomonde.
Ndamlumkisa unyana wam ukuba angajiki isidlele ngenxa yekratshi okanye ahambe emhlabeni ngenxa yekratshi.
Ndifundise unyana wam ukuba abe semgangathweni ngesantya aze athobe ilizwi, kuba esona sandi siqatha kukukhala kweedonki.

trial.label: Icebiso Lam Elibalaseleyo
options: Ndicebisa umntwana wam ukuba anganxulumani no-Allah
Ukwakha umkhombe ukuze usinde kumkhukula omkhulu
trial.answer: Ndicebisa umntwana wam ukuba anganxulumani no-Allah

outcome.label: Indlela Endikhunjulwa Ngayo
options: Njengokuba umntu etshonile kwisikhukula ngenxa yokungakholelwa
Njengomzekelo wombulelo kunye nesiluleko sobulumko sabazali
Njengomntu otshatyalaliswe kukuqhuma okukhulu okuvela esibhakabhakeni
outcome.answer: Njengomzekelo wombulelo kunye nesiluleko sobulumko sabazali

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
